verdict.rationale: Gumloop is a cloud-hosted AI agent platform, so choosing a data region or residency is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions region selection, data residency, or storage location controls. The Code Sandbox, Hosted MCPs on Gumloop's infrastructure, and the self-contained local installer are adjacent features and do not show a user-selectable storage region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
